content.name: ArgonMatt's ATF Valkyrie - L Frigate - (9.00+)
content.description:
[h1] L Frigate for the Terran ATF [/h1] (Same unlocking requirements as the Syn and Asgard, must be built by player.) To install the mod, simply hit the green 'Subscribe' button.
[b] [u] If you enjoy the mod, please leave a positive rating. (thumbs up) [/u] [/b] It helps the mod reach 5 stars and be recommended to more people that might like it, thanks!
[b] [u] The mod is, of course, free. However, if you'd like to support me, you can tip me at: https://ko-fi.com/argonmatt [/u] [/b]
[h1] Credit [/h1] A massive thank you to the Egosoft X4 modding discord community that helped make this ship possible, you guys are the real MVPs!
Language Translations:
Russian - Aladinaleks Chinese - 潜行飘过
[h1] Ship Equipment Slots [/h1] [list] [*] 1x L Engines [*] 1x L Shield Generators [*] 1x L Terran Main Battery [*] 16x M Turrets [*] 1x S Landing Pads (3x S Internal Storage) [/list]
The Valkyrie is currently balanced for the VANILLA version of X4: Foundations. Balance subject to change.
[h1] AI Support [/h1] Valkyrie Patrol Frigates will be created dynamically for the Terran Protectorate in your game. A maximum of 10 for all of the space that the Terran Protectorate controls. Each Valkyrie will be accompanied by a small wing of Terran fighters.
[h1] VRO [/h1] A patch for the VRO version of the Valkyrie can be found here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2904881034 Many thanks to EagleDelta2 for taking over the balancing of this ship!
[h1] Known Issues [/h1] Currently no known issues.
I'm happy to answer any questions you have about the ship in the comments section, thanks for viewing! :-)
